title: Multimodal edgecase playground — quick notes and ad-hoc rubric
content:
Notes to self: quick scratchpad for odd multimodal cases I keep hitting in nightly runs. Focus is on tiny, repeatable examples that show clear regressions or failure modes — easy to attach to a Linear issue. Keep short, mostly bullets.

Context: we rolled quantized vision-tower v2 on 2025-10-28 to production test pool. Nightly evals started showing more hallucinated labels for low-contrast images (e.g., old receipts, annotated diagrams). Need to capture examples + a tiny ad-hoc rubric for triage.

High-level observations (raw):
- Failure tilt: image->text pipeline often outputs confident but subtly wrong entity extraction (dates, amounts).
- Not consistent across seeds; seems correlated to JPEG artifacts + tiny fonts.
- OCR fallback path sometimes omitted when confidence threshold is exceeded but text is garbled.

Quick reproduction seeds (copy into eval harness):
1) Prompt: "Extract total amount and date from this receipt." Image: receipt-low-contrast-2024-05.jpg (attached to PR).
   - Expected: {amount: "$12.80", date: "2024-05-13"} (string form)
   - Observed: {amount: "$128.00", date: "May 2024"} — magnitude/error is large. Severity: high.
2) Prompt: "Summarize annotations on diagram; list labels and their color." Image: annotated-diagram-blur.png
   - Expected: 5 short label: color pairs
   - Observed: swapped labels, invented label "valve B" (not present). Severity: medium.
3) Prompt: "Caption this screenshot; include any visible filenames." Image: desktop-screenshot-small-font.png
   - Expected: reference to file names (e.g., 'report-final.pdf')
   - Observed: generic caption, missed filename. Severity: low.

Ad-hoc triage rubric (compact) — "3-tier multimodal fidelity" (use for quick triage on Linear):
- Level 0: Minor mismatch / fluff. Output is plausible, loses minor detail (formatting, punctuation). No user impact. (example: caption missing punctuation).
- Level 1: Incorrect but recoverable. Missing or swapped simple entities (dates, simple labels); user can infer correct answer or re-run prompt. Action: flag to QA; add targeted prompt/temperature test.
- Level 2: Dangerous/incorrect core data. Numeric or named entities are wrong (amounts, account ids, dosages), or hallucinated objects. Action: immediate rollback candidate; create regression PR with seed + ground truth.

Regression snapshot notes (2025-11-03 nightly):
- Test vector set: mm-mini-receipts-v3 (120 imgs).
- Baseline (vision-tower v1.9): entity-accurate 92% (strict match).
- Current (v2-q7): entity-accurate 78%.
- Delta: -14% absolute. Errors concentrated on receipts with contrast < 0.35 and font size < 8px equivalent.
- Quick hypothesis: quantization introduced brittle activation patterns in small-font OCR head. Also kernel reordering in fused-conv path may reduce preproc contrast normalization effectiveness.

Instrumentation traces to collect when filing issue:
- model logits for OCR head (save raw top-5 tokens)
- preproc histogram (contrast, noise) per image
- intermediate attention maps for last cross-attn block (sample up to 8 frames)
- prompt + temperature + seed used

Mini mitigation experiments to try (order):
1) Increase OCR confidence threshold fallback to trigger text-extract+voting heuristic for receipts only. Quick config change, low-risk.
2) Run targeted fine-tune on mm-mini-receipts-v3 for 2 epochs with distillation from v1.9. Watch overfitting.
3) Re-run fused-conv kernel ordering A/B to reproduce; add micro-benchmark for preproc contrast on unit tests.

Notes on annotation guidelines for these cases (so we can build better evals):
- Ground truth should include canonicalized numeric formats (strip currency symbols in GT column, store canonical numeric and original surface form).
- Add metadata: contrast ratio, font-estimate, compression-level. Use these as stratification keys.
- When label is ambiguous (stamped date vs printed), mark source = {OCR, visual-text, human-annotated}.

Unresolved questions / things to check quickly:
- Did v2-q7 change beam width or logit scaling? (I think PR #58 touched temperature scaling for multimodal head) — check linked PR.
- Are any preproc libraries upgraded between builds (libjpeg-turbo)? correlated with change in compression handling?
- Is there any correlation with routing policy that picks small-tensor kernels on T4 vs A100?

Action items (triage-ready):
- Create Linear issue with 3 worst receipts + rubric tag (assigned to Samir). Include raw traces and preproc histograms. (Blocking: need to attach seeds and full images).
- Quick config change: bump OCR fallback threshold to 0.6 for receipts-only in staging. Roll forward if nightly improves. (Owner: me).
- Add 30-image unit tests for contrast/font boundary to CI (Owner: Diego).

Quick draft of Linear title: "MM: Regression — v2-q7 increased OCR/label hallucinations on low-contrast receipts (delta -14%)"

Slack threads / references to include in issue: #mm-nightly, thread ts 170, 172 in #vision-observability.

Random micro-thoughts (brain dump):
- Could try tiny image augment chain that increases contrast slightly before feed; if helps, then this is preproc brittle not model.
- For annotated diagrams, add a sanity-check that label nouns appear in nearby text tokens before trusting them.

End of scratchpad — keep this lightweight. When filing issue, copy the "Quick reproduction seeds" and "Instrumentation traces" sections exactly into the template.

-- m
